translated.note: IL URL likely-pattern (site returned 403 for all requests; 172 articles previously translated, untranslated queue empty). Evidence: Lappin et al. 2003 double-blind RCT (n=37 RRMS, 25Hz PEMF, MFIS fatigue scale p=0.04, bladder function improvement); Piatkowski et al. 2009 double-blind RCT (n=27 SPMS, Modified Ashworth Scale 2.5→1.9 p=0.016); Richards et al. 2014 SR (Level B evidence for MS fatigue). Mechanisms: mitochondrial ATP upregulation (fatigue), Ca2+ channel normalization (spasticity), BDNF upregulation, neuroinflammation modulation (IL-1β/TNF-α suppression). 3-phase protocol: 10-25Hz foundation → 25-50Hz symptom-targeted → maintenance. Philippines: 4,000-7,000 diagnosed MS cases (likely 2-3x higher), MS population growing with expanding MRI/neurology access. Contraindications: DBS/VNS/intrathecal baclofen pump (absolute), active relapse (defer 4-6 weeks). Session cost: P1500-2500.
